BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-ISIS
BundleInfo.Author: NanoSyrinx
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Immunogenicity prediction: B-cell, T-cell and innate epitopes on structures
BundleInfo.Description:
ISIS (In Silico Immunogenicity Studies) predicts and visualises immunogenic features directly on an open structure, colouring residues by score and exporting per-residue values.
Prediction classes: B-cell linear - five amino-acid property scales, with consensus voting B-cell conformational - DiscoTope, ElliPro and SEPPA styles, using SASA, contact number and protrusion computed from the model T-cell - MHC class I and II binding from Random Forest models trained on IEDB data, plus proteasomal cleavage and TAP transport Innate - N-/O-glycosylation sequons, signal peptides, TLR motifs Structural features - SASA, protrusion index, contact number, B-factors
Also provides publication-style per-residue plots generated from the structure's own sequence, CSV/JSON export, and 'isis doctor' for diagnosing installation problems.
Every prediction class has been benchmarked against experimental data and the measured accuracy is reported by 'isis list', including the components that perform poorly. MHC-I binding is the most reliable (AUC 0.82-0.95 per allele); no conformational method beats plain solvent accessibility; four of the five linear B-cell scales do not exceed chance.
Requires the isis-epitope Python package in ChimeraX's own Python. Run 'isis doctor' if methods report themselves unavailable.
